channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tyrese Haliburton | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tyrese Haliburton from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Tony East:Rick Carlisle on Haliburton to start the season:

“I can't tell you exactly what the load is going to be. We will be in very animated communication about it with the training staff... at this point, it really appears he's made a great recovery.”

Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Keaton Wagler on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Keaton Wagler on comparison:

“I would say Tyrese Haliburton. I just think based off of our size that we both have and how we have the ball in our hands and can make plays, and knowing when it's our time to score the ball and when it's our time to get others involved and make the right play. That's a big thing for him is that he always makes the right play, and that's something that I always do too, is look to make the right play and play the right way.”

Keaton Wagler on Tyrese Haliburton, Jul 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Keaton Wagler on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Keaton Wagler on who he watches:

“I watch a lot of, you know, good NBA guards like Haliburton and SGA and a couple others. So I try to just steal little things out of, you know, each of those players, but I think the closest person is probably Haliburton, just off of size and the way we play, being able to have a really good feel for the game and use wall screens to create advantages.”

Keaton Wagler on Tyrese Haliburton, Jun 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Myles Turner on Pascal Siakam, Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Myles Turner:

“I couldn’t tell Tyrese, Pascal, Obi, TJ, or any of those guys what was really going on at the time because, one, it’s basically a breach when you’re in active negotiations. And two, I couldn’t show my hand. If I told them what was up, then all of a sudden it gets back to the front office like, ‘Oh, Myles, you’ve got this going on,’ and that could mess up my whole free-agency process. And mind you, this was my first time ever being a free agent—an unrestricted free agent. So I had to cherish that opportunity to choose, and I was going to take full advantage of it.”

Myles Turner on Pascal Siakam, Tyrese Haliburton, Mar 21, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Tristan Thompson, Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Rick Carlisle:

“My relationship with Tyrese Haliburton… The most compelling moment of that relationship was when he came here and the trade in late January of 22. He was shocked that they traded him. Whenyou travel west to east, you don't get to the east until late in the day because of all the time change stuff. And so we met at a restaurant. It was him, Buddy Hield, I think Tristan Thompson was in the deal as well. And Ty was the last guy to walk in. I went up and I shook hands. I looked him in the eye and I said,”

Rick Carlisle on Tristan Thompson, Tyrese Haliburton, Sep 26, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jeff Teague on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
However, Teague says that he tried to reach out to shake Haliburton’s hand at the event … only to get snubbed.

“I put my hand out to shake Tyrese’s hand at the wrestling event,”

Jeff Teague on Tyrese Haliburton, Sep 25, 2025. Source: Larry Brown Sports.

item.title: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Donovan Mitchell, Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Kentavious Caldwell-Pope:

“But we’re talking about superstars. We’re talking about guys who get teams involved, elevate players, and when my team needs a win — they go get it. I can’t do that with Donovan Mitchell. And I’m 50/50 on Haliburton. He might average 25 and 8, but he’s not consistent. He’s clutch now, sure, but not consistent enough throughout the game. I need someone who shoots consistently, makes plays all game long. He’s getting there — but he’s not quite there yet.”

Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Donovan Mitchell, Tyrese Haliburton, Jul 3, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Adam Silver on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Silver, speaking to ESPN as part of its NBA draft coverage, said there weren't any in the NBA in the previous season.

“We had already convened a panel of experts before Tyrese's most recent Achilles rupture,”

Adam Silver on Tyrese Haliburton, Jun 25, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Paul George on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Paul George on Tyrese Haliburton injury:

“I knew it was over from the moment, you know, you saw that. Um, which is unfortunate cuz he came out hot, you know what I mean? He came out as a leader. Um, you could tell he was ready. He was prepared. Um, and then I knew right away once I seen him fall down. Then they replayed it. He looked back to see what happened. And then you you could you know read his lips when shout out Josh Corbiel who uh you know the trainer that was there um the first respond there you you could see him say like yep yep he it's done it's done it like I did it I did it happened. So yeah I feel for him feel for him.”

Paul George on Tyrese Haliburton, Jun 24, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Pacers coach Rick Carlisle:

“Tyrese is gonna play. He was strength tested at 5 pm and did very well. No minutes limit. We will monitor things very closely.”

Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton, Jun 19, 2025. Source: Twitter @VinceGoodwill.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
For Daigneault, hobbled or not, he doesn't want to take any chances on seeing the Thunder underestimating Haliburton's ability to help his team even the NBA Finals, 3-3, and force a potential Game 7.

“Haliburton’s a great player. One thing we know is you don’t underestimate great players. So, in the case that he plays, we’re expecting his best punch,”

Mark Daigneault on Tyrese Haliburton, Jun 18, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Dan Devine:Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton, who finished with four points on 0-for-6 shooting in 34 minutes where he looked very hampered by a calf issue:

“He's not 100%. It's pretty clear. But I don't think he's gonna miss the next game.”

Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton, Jun 16, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Drew Hanlen on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
“The biggest thing holding [Haliburton] back was his lack of scoring aggressiveness. So I presented a challenge to him. I told him that if he wanted to work with me, he had to have 14 field goal attempts the next night against the Sixers.”

Drew Hanlen on Tyrese Haliburton, Jun 7, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Luguentz Dort on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Lu Dort on Tyrese Haliburton:

“He’s a good player. He’s their main guy obviously. He has the ball a lot. The way I approach any matchup is I gotta make it tough. Not only me but the whole team.”

Luguentz Dort on Tyrese Haliburton, Jun 2, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Josh Hart on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Knicks forward Josh Hart said.

“We’re asking a lot from ’Kal. He’s picking him up, running around with him. Tyrese is someone who never really stops moving. He’ll bring the ball down, he’ll hit, he’ll run off of it, he’ll get the [ball] back, he’ll throw it back to the big, he’ll run back. ’Kal did a great job today trying to be physical, trying to be on his body and not give him anything easy.”

Josh Hart on Tyrese Haliburton, May 31, 2025. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Carlisle on Haliburton's shots:

“As a team, we have to be aggressive and we have to have a level of balance. I'll look at it. There's things I'm going to have to do to help him.”

Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton, May 29, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton:

“He was the leader tonight. We had some tough film stuff..... We allowed things to go a different direction than they needed to go in Game 3. We were determined to make it go in a different direction.”

Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton, May 27, 2025. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Rick Carlisle:

“I get tired of talking about individual numbers. ...Tyrese is a great player. I think people realize that. He happens to do some really impressive statistical things. But he's well aware that all of this far transcends statistics.”

Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton, May 27, 2025. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Cooper Flagg on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
“I would say Tyrese Haliburton, because people hate him and call him overrated all the time and say he's not that good, but he's just such a good basketball player.”

Cooper Flagg on Tyrese Haliburton, May 15, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Tony East:Kenny Atkinson on limiting Tyrese Haliburton:

“Just will. Just be opportunistic. He's so slippery. It's not a guy that's stagnant and doesn't move. He runs as much as anybody in the league. Reminds me of Steph. We've been trying to do our best trying to limit his touches.”

Kenny Atkinson on Tyrese Haliburton, May 11, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Tyrese Maxey, Tyrese Haliburton, Jaden McDaniels
item.description:
Anthony Edwards:

“Me at one. I would go LaMelo at two. I'm going Tyrese Maxey at three. Tyrese Haliburton at four. I'm going Jayden, Jaden McDaniels... Nah, I'm going Jayden for sure.”

Anthony Edwards on Tyrese Maxey, Tyrese Haliburton, Jaden McDaniels, Apr 30, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Brandon Jennings on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Brandon Jennings on Tyrese Haliburton:

“I don't think he's the most overrated player in the NBA. I mean, we can find somebody else. Um, but yeah, I just think, you know, I just don't think they like his game. I think it's just Indiana, you know. Um, buthe's not he's not the most overrated player in the NBA. I'm not I'm not I'm not rolling with that at all.”

Brandon Jennings on Tyrese Haliburton, Apr 26, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Thomas Bryant on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Thomas Bryant on Tyrese Haliburton:

“He makes the game so much easier for everybody. ... He creates so much stuff and for us. He's so unselfish that that he makes the game easier for anybody.”

Thomas Bryant on Tyrese Haliburton, Jan 8, 2025. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: LeBron James on Jrue Holiday, Devin Booker, Anthony Edwards, Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
LeBron on Anthony Edwards:

“That was the best thing about our team. You know, we had the vets—myself, Steph, KD, AD, Jrue Holiday—and then you had the younger guys, Tyrese Haliburton, Anthony Edwards, Devin Booker. Just to see the excitement that Ant-Man played with, showed off the floor, he wanted to compete against everybody. You probably saw him want to compete versus the Team USA ping pong team. He said he could beat people in swimming, you know. He wanted to compete versus everybody. And just to see that electric and that energy from the young guy, and for us as the older guys remembering at one point having all that energy, it was definitely a blessing for sure to be around.”

LeBron James on Jrue Holiday, Devin Booker, Anthony Edwards, Tyrese Haliburton, Sep 21, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jayson Tatum, Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
“Jayson handled things so well. Then obviously it became a media subject, but he couldn’t have handled it better. Tyrese, same thing. Every game was different. And we talked about that from the first night – 12 superstars and probably only nine can play consistent minutes. They handled themselves really professionally and pulled for each other. I couldn’t be prouder of them all.”

Steve Kerr on Jayson Tatum, Tyrese Haliburton, Sep 15, 2024. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Todd Ramasar on Andrew Nembhard, Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Todd Ramasar:

“Even though the season started off slowly, it was a natural progression for him where he got better every month. The whole world got to really see Andrew on display in the playoffs with Tyrese there. Once Tyrese went down with injuries, you saw Andrew be in his natural position as the primary ball handler. You saw him step up and play huge for his team. Unfortunately, the team fell short. Andrew, like a lot of young players, learned from the experience with being in the playoffs. But the team has always valued Andrew as being one of their own and has always seen him as an integral part. That’s what led to the extension being done now.”

Todd Ramasar on Andrew Nembhard, Tyrese Haliburton, Jul 29, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on Tyrese Haliburton:

“We played together last year. We came up short. We got one common goal in mind and that’s to not come up short this year. We the youngins. We might be in this thing a few years to come. That’s my brother.”

Anthony Edwards on Tyrese Haliburton, Jul 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Tom Thibodeau on Tyrese Haliburton:

“He's a great player. We have to do better. He does it all. He can shoot, put it on the floor. Pass.”

Tom Thibodeau on Tyrese Haliburton, May 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Obi Toppin on Myles Turner, Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Obi Toppin:

“It’s easy to play with Tyrese. He’s so willing to give up the ball. But he’s such a threat offensively with his scoring that he draws so much attention. That allows other people to get open. They found a way to play with each other. It’s been great. It’s just like Tyrese and Myles Turner. With both of them, I think they’re the best duo in pick-and-roll in the league. I think so. Don’t quote me on that.”

Obi Toppin on Myles Turner, Tyrese Haliburton, Mar 28, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
“I thought it was one of Tyrese's most important games. The offense didn't come easy early. But he kept running the team...he played the long game. He knew at some point during the game, things would pop,”

Rick Carlisle on Tyrese Haliburton, Feb 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @TonyREast.
